hero.description: Experience a new standard of medical excellence. Dwarika Hospital combines world-class clinical expertise with an empathetic heart, powered by advanced technology.

about.title: About Dwarika Hospital
about.introduction: Dwarika Hospital & Medical Academy Pvt. Ltd. is a pioneer in bringing advanced healthcare to the heart of Madhesh Province. Established to bridge the gap in quality medical services, we combine clinical excellence with compassionate service.
about.mission_text: To provide high-quality, affordable and patient-centered healthcare to our community, ensuring essential services are accessible to all near their homes.
about.vision_text: To grow into a 100-bed, multi-specialty teaching hospital recognized across Nepal for clinical excellence, modern infrastructure, and strong academic programs.
about.values_text: Accessibility, Compassion, and Integrity shape how we care for every patient and family, fostering a partnership for continuous health improvement.

holistic.title: Holistic Healing
